summary: Fits a plane to a2 points at a1 (stride 28 bytes, doubles at offsets +0/+8/+16) by accumulating least-squares normal-equation sums and solving the resulting 3x4 augmented system via sub_5677B0; on a failed solve writes a normalized fallback plane. The canonical/ABI name (BestFitPlaneFitting / Best_Fit_Plane_Fitting) supports the plane-fit reading, but ownership and exact output layout (a3/a4 written via dword stores) are unresolved.

operations.description: Zero the 12-element double accumulator array v21 and build the 3-element row-pointer array v20 pointing at v21, v21+4 and v21+8 to form a 3x4 augmented matrix.
Accumulate sums only when a2 > 0; otherwise skip straight to the solve.
Solve the 3x4 augmented system by calling sub_5677B0(v20, 3); a nonzero return indicates a solved (non-degenerate) system.
On successful solve, write six dwords to a3 (0, 0, 0, 1072693248, 0, 0 - interpretable as the double triple 0.0, 0.0, 1.0) and copy the double at a1+8 into a4.
On failed solve, compute a normalized fallback plane: v18 = 1/sqrt(v21[7]*v21[7] + v21[3]*v21[3] + 1.0); set a3[0] = -(v21[3]*v18), a3[1] = v18, a3[2] = -(v21[7]*v18) and a4[0] = v18 * v21[11].
Return a4 as the result pointer.
